method.G_prime_semantics: Nominal residual-slot graph, retaining duplicate input slots; not the physically essential dependency graph.
method.cdf_discrepancy: max_k distance from Poisson CDF to [F_lower(k),F_upper(k)] is a conservative lower bound; maximum absolute endpoint distance is an upper bound. All integer k through max upper cost suffice because empirical CDF is then one and the Poisson tail decreases.
method.chi_square_numerics: Independently implemented integer/half-integer gamma recurrence; every exported p-value bound and 200 numerical cases additionally checked against scipy.stats.chi2.sf.
method.cost_intervals: Pointwise empirical PMF/CDF and raw moment bounds are partial identification intervals, not confidence intervals. No midpoint imputation.
method.empirical_counts: Exact integer histograms and sums; all draws retained.
method.endpoint_SE: sqrt((N sum X^2 - (sum X)^2)/(N^2(N-1))) for X=L^r or U^r; cost moment SE only when every interval is a singleton.
method.failure_CI: Pointwise equal-tailed 95% Clopper-Pearson beta quantiles; scipy.special.betaincinv supplies expected limits, checked by independent binomial-tail summation. Every exported primary endpoint is also checked against scipy.stats.beta.ppf.
method.seed_identity: Protocol master_seed, mixture_id, n, and replicate tuples; checks complete identical record identities, not numerical RNG replay.

scope: Independent arithmetic aggregation and raw-record integrity; no production modules imported; no network regeneration or dynamic witness verification in this script.
